creative_direction.audience: a viewer encountering a quiet, unforced cafe moment in a social feed
creative_direction.desired_response: the scene feels found rather than staged: the room and light register first, then the coherent tray group rewards a second look
creative_direction.art_direction: one deliberately small right-front exact beverage, one small left-front generic drink and one rear-center carafe form an unequal triangle on a complete round dark tray
creative_direction.restraint: keep 0.50-0.60 meaningful release; the room and empty table dominate before the compact tray group is noticed

reference_binding.runtime_role: offline measurement authority for camera, scale, tray relationships, plane-specific daylight and restrained tone

camera_geometry.distortion: natural tray ellipse and straight vessel axes with no wide-phone looming or stretched frame edges
camera_geometry.depth_of_field: all three tray items, support contacts and the tray rim resolve together while only distant room microdetail falls away

composition_geometry.bbox_semantics: the exact right-front beverage body stays 0.13-0.15 of frame width and 0.15-0.18 of frame height; this is a precompensated hard maximum because the provider otherwise enlarges the foreground group
composition_geometry.negative_space: 0.50-0.60 meaningful release through room depth and exposed white table around the deliberately small complete tray

support_plane.kind: one complete round dark oiled-wood tray on one white circular table
support_plane.perspective: the tray ellipse spans only 0.44-0.50 of frame width, no more than 0.31 frame height, and binds three unequal physical contacts

composition_geometry.frame_rhythm: dominant room and empty table, then a small low-middle asymmetric triangle: left drink, rear carafe and right-front exact beverage
composition_geometry.crop_policy: step back until the complete tray group is contained inside a 0.50-wide by 0.31-high envelope with white-table margin on every side
forbidden: tray width outside 0.44-0.50 or tray height above 0.31
copied heater, plant, lamp or furniture

composition_variation.selection: derive only minor slot spacing, wood-grain phase and far-room sunlight spacing from the request seed
invariants: 45-50mm camera stepped back 190-250cm at 30-36 degree pitch
hard sun in the far room and open shade over the tray
composition_variation.repeat_guard: do not recreate reference beverage contents, text, identifiable furnishings, exact floor pattern or exact shadow silhouette

lighting_geometry.source_topology: direct daylight makes hard architectural bands in the far room; the foreground tray is lit by open shade and broad back-right window bounce
lighting_geometry.highlight_behavior: distant sunlit areas stay bright but textured; foreground glass and ceramic receive broad restrained edge lift without clipping
lighting_geometry.optical_effects: bounded beverage transmission, subtle glass caustics and local dark-wood reflections share one daylight direction
forbidden: hard spotlight on the exact drink
same shadow hardness on near and far planes

tone_signature.black_point: deep neutral chocolate-brown with readable pores
tone_signature.contrast_curve: weighted toe for the tray, clean midtone separation and a soft shoulder over sunlit room areas
tone_signature.saturation: restrained environment with no global brown grade; the exact beverage keeps source-authoritative color
tone_signature.shadow_color: neutral brown-gray with a faint cool counterbalance
tone_signature.material_separation: dark oiled wood, white table, white saucer, clear glass, drinks and room remain independently colored
tone_signature.local_contrast: moderate at rims, liquid boundaries, contacts and tray grain; restrained in the distant room

finish_signature.acuity: finite twelve-to-sixteen-megapixel-like detail with no uniform high-resolution crispness
finish_signature.microcontrast: selective on beverage surfaces and tray contacts, gently reduced across the room and table edges
finish_signature.grain: faint shared low-contrast luminance texture that never becomes a filter effect
finish_signature.depth_rendering: normal-lens scale, tray ellipse, overlap, contact and plane-specific light establish depth before restrained far-plane softness
finish_signature.retouching: retain small condensation, wood and spacing irregularities while rebuilding all container optics under the target light

hard_fail: exact beverage width or height falls outside the target range
round tray width or silhouette falls outside the target range
exact beverage count differs from one
selected container design or immediate support is missing
hard far-room sun and open-shade foreground collapse into one light treatment
